approved_scope.title: Chough gate list: one-screen gate summaries with digests, and one reply for listed gates only (184, FLOW-19, FLOW-20)
approved_scope.description: chough gate list: one-screen gate summaries with digests, and one reply for listed gates only (184, FLOW-19, FLOW-20)
acceptance_criteria: REQ-cli-061 and REQ-history-014 (new), REQ-cli-059 (modified): chough gate list numbers every open human gate with a one-screen summary (what changed since the change's base, the tests, the risks, a diff link) and its SHA-256 digest, saved untracked, with no native read; chough gate record closes only listed gates with one relay, each keeping its own summary digest and the list, all or none, refusing an unknown list, an unlisted number, a closed gate, a changed summary, or a verifying change (each naming a recovery a test runs); chough change ship takes --list and --gate for the review gate. The change log names the oldest Chough that reads summary digests. Six tests in tests/gates.rs fail first, each mutant in testing.md fails one, and fledge run linux-verify passes.

answers.constraints: Issue #184, slice 4 of Chough drives SpecSync; slice order approved by Leif (relayed by the orc). FLOW-19 and FLOW-20 (answers 2 and 3), FLOW-16 as amended and FLOW-10; DRIVE-2 (no native read), DRIVE-4 (the review gate closes through ship, not in the verification window), DRIVE-12. Modifies REQ-cli-059 for --list/--gate. History compatibility: older Chough refuses the new relay fields, and the change log names the oldest reader. IDs REQ-cli-061 and REQ-history-014 confirmed free with t27. Native records are slice 5 (SpecSync 6.3.0 with #900). Lesson: run the spec coverage check locally before Linux verify.
